report_summary.summary: Executable budget contract only. No 24/7 soak, 1,000-node simulation, GPU/training, robotics, or live fleet benchmark was executed by this fixture.

latency_budgets.description: Append one local event/evidence envelope with required integrity and identity checks.

measurement_boundary.notes: Storage engine write latency is captured as Splendor control-plane overhead; provider/model time is excluded.

latency_budgets.description: Commit one validated state node and state-head update with trace linkage.

measurement_boundary.notes: State integrity and trace linkage checks are included.

latency_budgets.description: Evaluate a cached but unexpired authority/capability decision with denial evidence available.

measurement_boundary.notes: The decision includes expiry/revocation/cache-freshness checks, not external IdP latency.

latency_budgets.description: Run required pre-execution gateway/verifier checks before adapter invocation.

measurement_boundary.notes: All required verifiers remain enabled; adapter execution/provider time is excluded.

latency_budgets.description: Kernel scheduling/invocation bookkeeping overhead around a model call, excluding model/provider compute and network time.

measurement_boundary.notes: Provider/model/training latency must be reported in separate user-space/provider metrics.

latency_budgets.description: Route one authenticated percept into a bounded inbox with provenance/evidence retained.

measurement_boundary.notes: Perceptor/source work is excluded; Splendor provenance and queue admission checks are included.

latency_budgets.description: Admit one agent tick after identity, quota, state-head, and policy freshness checks.

measurement_boundary.notes: Policy/model execution is excluded; admission checks remain enabled.

throughput_budgets.description: Sustained event/evidence ingestion into local control-plane storage.

measurement_boundary.notes: Metric includes integrity and append-order checks.

throughput_budgets.description: Control-plane artifact transfer coordination and receipt processing, not provider blob-store bandwidth.

measurement_boundary.notes: Payload bytes and storage-provider throughput are separate provider metrics.

throughput_budgets.description: Scheduler offer evaluations that preserve authority, quota, and resource checks.

measurement_boundary.notes: Does not include cloud/Kubernetes provider scheduling latency.

throughput_budgets.description: Workload lifecycle state transitions with mutation receipt/evidence retained.

measurement_boundary.notes: Transition evidence and fencing checks are included.

throughput_budgets.description: Feedback event ingestion with provenance, non-reward separation, and bounded summaries.

measurement_boundary.notes: Reward derivation and evaluator work are separate budgets.

throughput_budgets.description: Evaluation fan-out control-plane dispatch and result receipt accounting, not evaluator/model runtime.

measurement_boundary.notes: Evaluator execution and model inference are excluded.

throughput_budgets.description: Reference-scale simulated fleet control-plane heartbeats/offers/transitions for 1,000 nodes.

measurement_boundary.notes: This budget requires future simulation harness evidence; this fixture does not execute the simulation.

retention_backpressure_actions.trigger: event partitions approach configured storage growth budget
retention_backpressure_actions.action: compact or archive eligible event partitions while preserving required evidence, hash links, and replay references

retention_backpressure_actions.trigger: event payload summaries approach bounded trace payload budget
retention_backpressure_actions.action: reject unbounded payloads and require artifact reference/offload remediation

retention_backpressure_actions.trigger: bounded percept inbox approaches high-water mark
retention_backpressure_actions.action: throttle or defer source admission with trace-visible drop/defer evidence instead of unbounded memory growth

retention_backpressure_actions.trigger: scheduler usage predicts live inference SLO breach
retention_backpressure_actions.action: deny, pause, or preempt lower-priority background workloads before protected inference capacity is breached
